extraction.NOTES: This is a general administrative letter dated December 7, 1928, from E. W. Jermark, Superintendent, Pine Ridge Agency, to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, acknowledging receipt of a letter of December 4, 1928, regarding Circular No. 2464. Reports that 247 Indians have made statements so far. Notes that county seat records have not yet been examined but will be the following week. Notes that cases eligible for cancellation under the Act of February 26, 1927 (44 Stats.1247) require immediate action, and that previously submitted cases have seen no action in over a year.
